about.title: About Parker Russell Serbia
about.lead: Established in 2016, Parker Russell d.o.o. Belgrade is an audit and consulting firm serving domestic and international businesses in Serbia.
about.body: The firm combines expertise across audit, accounting, taxation, business consulting, valuation and internal audit, supporting organisations with financial reporting, compliance, transactions, internal controls and wider business requirements.
